name: Alice's Sister

gender_note.quote: the book her sister was reading

base_age_note.reason: Source never states her age; H1 ruling 5.6 A fixes 'mid-teens'.

hair.color: warm mid-brown, a shade darker than Alice's
hair.style: centre parting, smoothed over the ears and gathered into a low chignon at the nape in a fine dark hairnet — the grown-up style that separates her from loose-haired Alice
hair.reason: Not described; family resemblance to CHAR-alice plus the 1862 convention that a girl of fifteen or sixteen begins to wear her hair up.

eyes.shape: calm, slightly heavy-lidded, often lowered to her book
eyes.reason: Not described; shared family trait with CHAR-alice. Lowered gaze follows her reading (ch001-p01) and closed-eyed reverie (ch012-p70).

skin.tone: fair, kept pale under a hat brim
skin.reason: Not described; a young lady of the period shading her face outdoors.

face.shape: longer oval than Alice's — the same face grown up
features: same straight nose and brows as Alice
face.default_expression: quiet and absorbed; tender and amused when she wakes Alice
face.quote: her sister kissed her / leaning her head on her hand, watching the setting sun
face.reason: Manner is sourced; facial structure designed to read as Alice's elder sister at a glance.

build.body_type: slender, graceful, sits still for long periods
build.scale_reference: about 1.2x Alice's true size (135 cm); seated on the bank Alice's head fits in her lap
build.quote: with her head in the lap of her sister
build.reason: Height not stated; typical mid-teen girl of her class in 1862.

marks.description: rests her head on one hand while thinking
a small cloth-bound book with no pictures

default_outfit_tone.summary: soft lilac-grey summer muslin day dress, long sleeves, skirt to the ankle, a small white collar, wide-brimmed straw hat with a plain ribbon set beside her on the bank
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: young lady's day dress over a modest cage crinoline, fitted bodice, ankle-length skirt — visibly more grown-up than Alice's knee-length child's dress
default_outfit_tone.reason: Dress not described; 1862 clergyman-scholar family, summer afternoon on the bank. Full costume by 06-art/costume.

doubling.ruling: H1 5.3 B — sister glimpsed at the trial
doubling.dream_form: a spectator glimpsed in the courtroom gallery (ch011-ch012), played by the same actress
changes: a dark shawl over the shoulders and a small plain bonnet over the chignon so she blends into the gallery crowd
no card or animal coding — she is the one person in the court who is not a dream-figure
doubling.limits: only glimpsed (background or brief insert), never speaks in the dream; she must be recognisable on the wake-up cut back to the bank
doubling.reason: Staging beat designed to realise ruling 5.3 B; not stated in the source text.

prompt_base_en: a fifteen-year-old English young lady in 1862, warm-brown hair parted in the centre and gathered in a low chignon in a fine hairnet, calm grey-blue eyes, fair skin, slender, lilac-grey ankle-length summer muslin day dress with a small white collar, holding a small cloth-bound book
